body: Worker trap (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-23 00:10Z; my own miss on the w-33f4 GREEN-5 run test-741e4bde, 34/0, which ended with verificationRecordIds = []). I waited for the focused-run cap with a Bash run_in_background until-loop that polled /api/test-runs. TermAl counts any Bash-background command as Claude background work. While it runs, this session's evidence is restricted: tests may pass without earning verification credit, and a grant that overlaps it keeps its source report withheld. The loop exited before the foreground run started, yet the run still got no host record. Rule: to wait for peer runs to drop under the cap, use termal_resume_after_test_runs (an any-of END wait on the active run ids), then end the turn. Never use a Bash background loop or Monitor for this. Fable2 #569 confirmed it.
